syllabusSource.title: PDEU course handout 2024-25 (CHEM semester 2): Computer Programming - II Laboratory
syllabusSource.note: Units and topics copied from the course handout PDF (pages 5 of CHEM/sem2/Chemical_Semester_2_Course_Handout.pdf). New in Prism: no curated sources or checked lessons yet.

topics.name: Language fundamentals: understanding interpretation, program execution flow, tokens, variables, keywords and identifiers, constants and variables.
Input-output operations: basic data types, mutability, immutability, operators, input/output statements, format specifiers, escape sequences.
Decision making and looping control structures: if, elif and else, nesting; iterative statements - for, while, for-else, while-else; transfer statements - break, continue, pass.
Advanced data types: string, list, tuples, dictionary, set.
Functions: basics of functions, types of arguments.
Types of functions: anonymous functions, function aliasing, nested functions, decorator functions and generator functions.
Object oriented programming: class, object, types of variables and methods, composition, aggregation, inheritance, types of inheritance.
File handling: writing and reading with text files and CSV files, working with directories, pickling and unpickling. Max 26 Hrs
